## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** “最早何时到达东亚”长期是早期人类扩散研究的关键问题。格鲁吉亚Dmanisi约185万—178万年前的人属化石提供了非洲以外早期人类的经典锚点；中国上陈、西侯度等遗址则有更早石器，但缺乏与之直接对应的人骨。郧县三具头骨因此特别重要：它们既有明确化石实体，又长期受年代不确定性制约。新的宇生核素埋藏测年把争论从“是否很早”推进到“约177万年的年代是否真正代表头骨埋藏事件”。

**English.** The timing of the earliest hominin presence in East Asia is a long-standing question in human dispersal studies. Dmanisi provides the classic early extra-African fossil benchmark, whereas Chinese sites such as Shangchen and Xihoudu have very early lithic claims without directly associated hominin fossils. The Yunxian crania are therefore unusually important because they are substantial fossils whose interpretation has long been constrained by chronology. The new cosmogenic burial age shifts the debate toward whether ~1.77 Ma truly dates the depositional history of the crania.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 新的沉积年代研究把郧县人头骨所在层位修正到约177万年前，使这批原位头骨成为东亚最早的一组可靠直立人化石记录之一。

**English.** New sediment dating places the Yunxian crania at about 1.77 million years ago, making them among the earliest securely contextualized Homo erectus fossils in eastern Asia.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 这项研究的关键争点不能只写成“与近年形态学研究存在张力”。Feng et al. 2025 在 *Science* 发表的郧县2号重建研究把该头骨放在约100万年前的亚洲 *Homo longi* 支系中，并认为这一支系包括丹尼索瓦人。2026年的1.77±0.08 Ma新年代因此把同一化石向前推了约60万年。该2025研究的共同作者 Chris Stringer 随后公开表示，如果郧县确实接近180万年前，它会“完全不同步于其余化石记录”，并主张进一步复核遗址年代。换言之，本项发现真正重要的不只是“东亚更早出现直立人”，而是它迫使年代学与形态—系统发育两套证据重新对接。

**English.** The key controversy should be stated explicitly rather than described vaguely as a “tension” with recent morphology. Feng et al. (2025), in *Science*, reconstructed Yunxian 2 as an approximately one-million-year-old early member of the Asian *Homo longi* clade, which they linked closely to Denisovans. The 2026 burial age of 1.77 ± 0.08 Ma therefore moves the same fossil roughly 600,000 years earlier. Chris Stringer, a co-author of the 2025 study, subsequently commented that placing Yunxian at nearly 1.8 Ma would put it “completely out of sync with the rest of the fossil record” and called for further dating work. The discovery is therefore important not only because it may extend the East Asian hominin timeline, but because it forces chronological and morphological-phylogenetic evidence to be reconciled.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

Tu, H., Feng, X., Luo, L., Lai, Z., Granger, D., Bae, C., & Shen, G. (2026). The oldest in situ <i>Homo erectus</i> crania in eastern Asia: The Yunxian site dates to ~1.77 Ma. Science Advances, 12(8). https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.ady2270

**开放获取状态 | Open-access status.** 文章可在线访问；再利用许可与图像权利按出版方rights statement和单幅图署名核查。 / The article is accessible online; reuse and figure rights follow the publisher rights statement and individual credits.

**出版物内容（中文）。** 文章利用与郧县头骨同层石英砾石的宇生核素 ²⁶Al/¹⁰Be 埋藏测年，将化石层位测定为 1.77±0.08 Ma。其核心贡献是把东亚原位人类头骨记录推进到接近德马尼西的年代，但这一年代与近期形态学解释之间仍存在需要进一步检验的张力。

**What the publication shows (English).** The study uses cosmogenic ²⁶Al/¹⁰Be burial dating of quartz clasts from the fossil-bearing layer to obtain an age of 1.77 ± 0.08 Ma. Its main contribution is to place securely contextualized East Asian hominin crania close in age to Dmanisi, while leaving an important tension with recent morphological interpretations that requires further testing.

### 相关背景文献 | Relevant background publication

Feng, X., Yin, Q., Gao, F., Lu, D., Fang, Q., Feng, Y., Huang, X., Tan, C., Zhou, H., Li, Q., Zhang, C., Stringer, C., & Ni, X. (2025). The phylogenetic position of the Yunxian cranium elucidates the origin of *Homo longi* and the Denisovans. *Science, 389*(6767), 1320–1324. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.ado9202

**出版物内容（中文）。** 该研究数字复原郧县2号头骨，并通过形态测量与系统发育分析把它置于亚洲 *Homo longi* 支系的早期位置；这构成2026年新年代最重要的比较背景。

**What the publication shows (English).** This study digitally reconstructed Yunxian 2 and used morphometric and phylogenetic analyses to place it as an early member of the Asian *Homo longi* clade; it provides the most important comparative framework against which the 2026 chronology must be evaluated.
